# Quarterly Goals 2025

Tags: #team #planning

## Q1 Goals

Finish custom networking for pod IPs, reach 95% Terraform coverage, and reduce monthly cloud spend by 8%. Result: IPs done after the January incident; coverage 94%; spend down 6%.

## Q2 Goals

Cut paging noise to under 5 actionable pages per on-call week, run the first DR game day, and move legacy deploys to Argo CD. Result: DR game day happened in May, noise at 7 per week, Argo covered 85% of services.

## Q3 Goals

Eliminate IAM user keys, enable Thanos downsampling, and pilot Karpenter in staging. Result: 2 keys remain, downsampling slipped to Q4, Karpenter pilot successful.

## Q4 Goals

Upgrade to Kubernetes 1.30, migrate `orders` to Postgres 15, and automate TLS inventory after the September certificate incident. Owners are listed in the planning ticket.
